I saved the draft to Hollis and told Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting for someone to send it.

- **Draft:** It goes to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. - proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate Marcus supplied and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Approval:** Hollis isn't Thornbury's account owner, so the rate needed sign-off from Anselm or June. Anselm's message is that sign-off, so I didn't need to request approval separately. The mail stays inside pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval wasn't needed.
- **Knowledge brain (gbrain):** It refused my search because its connection isn't linked to the member being served. I didn't need it, since Anselm's message had the figure. To fix it, someone on the brain host can link the connection to a member with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
